accounts.handOverDescription: The account stops being yours and moves to the fund with everything it holds: balance, movements and pockets. Any member of the fund will see it and be able to record movements in it. Its movements start counting in the fund and stop counting in your personal budgets; transfers to your other accounts become visible to every member too. Its personal categories are swapped for the fund's category with the same name; if one is missing, it does not move. The incomes it already has stay «Unassigned» in the contributions. webhooks.mcpDescription: On claude.ai (web, desktop or mobile), add a custom connector with the URL above: it asks you to sign in with HomeFund and that is all. Claude reads your accounts, movements and «Review the month», and records movements or creates and edits accounts and categories once you confirm, always with your own permissions; revoking its key in the list disconnects it. A key you create here still works: in Claude Code it goes in «Authorization: Bearer», and in a connector with no sign-in in the «X-API-Key» header. A webhook key does not open this door. To talk to HomeFund and GoalLog in one chat, the repository github.com/WAB-Studio/asistente (private to WAB-Studio) has it all set up: follow its README.

mcp.instructions: HomeFund is a household's books: accounts, movements and a shared fund. Amounts are whole cents with their currency. Read with the tools; never invent movements. Write only what the person confirmed.

tools.listAccounts: The open accounts the person can see, personal and the fund's, with their balance per currency in cents. A pocket carries parentAccountId, the account it sits inside; a parent's balances are its own free part, without its pockets.
tools.reviewMonth: «Review the month»: the movements that stand out in a closed month by fixed rules (an amount far above its category's usual, two equal on one day, an amount read from words, a reconciliation gap), and whether each is already marked fine.
tools.monthParam: The month, YYYY-MM. Absent, the last closed month.
tools.previewStatement: Step 1 of importing a bank statement: says what each line would do, writing nothing. Each line: «new» (will be created), «matches» (already recorded by hand or as a transfer's other side; only linked), «already_imported» (skipped) or «invalid» (with its reason). «proposal» is the account the person used before for that description: ask them before passing it as counterAccountId. A transfer with an account in another currency carries «counter»: ask the person how much arrived (or left) in that account, pass it as counterAmountCents and confirm the resulting rate with them. Always pass «statement» (periodStart and cutOffDate as the statement prints them, and its closing balance when printed): the cut-off date is how a re-import finds the same statement, and every line must fall inside the period. «removals» lists what a re-import of that statement would drop because its lines no longer name it («deletes» removes the movement, «unlinks» only this statement's link to it): show it to the person. Show the summary to the person before step 2.
tools.importStatement: Step 2: imports exactly what preview_statement showed, with its previewKey. All or nothing: if a line changed, or what the preview said about it, or one is invalid, nothing is written and it asks for a new preview. Repeating it never duplicates movements: what was imported shows as «already_imported». Re-importing a statement replaces its rows: lines it no longer names are removed (as the preview's «removals» said), new ones are added and unchanged ones keep their category, labels and notes.
tools.listCategories: The categories the person can use, personal and the fund's, with id, name, kind (expense or income), parent and scope (personal or fund). Always pick one from here for a movement; if none fits, propose creating one with create_category.
tools.listMovements: Recent movements, newest first, of one account or all, filtered by dates (YYYY-MM-DD) and by category (a category includes its subcategories): id, date, description, amount in cents, currency, source and destination accounts and its lines (splits: category, amount and product description). limit and offset page through an account that holds more than 200. Call it BEFORE record_movement to see whether it is already recorded and not duplicate it.
tools.recordMovement: Records an expense (fromAccountId only), an income (toAccountId only) or a transfer (both); the kind comes from the accounts. Amount in whole cents, date YYYY-MM-DD, never in the future. An expense or income carries a category (categoryId, or splits summing to the amount); a transfer none. Paying a card or a loan, lending or receiving a loan, and moving money between the person's own accounts is a TRANSFER (fromAccountId and toAccountId both set), never an expense or income; if the account is missing (the card, the loan, an «Owes me <person>» asset), propose creating it with create_account in the same confirmation list. The description says what and where («Ara — Champiñón 250 g»), never the payment method or account, which the movement already carries. A receipt with several products is ONE movement: each product is a split with its description (the name), its amount in cents and its category from list_categories, and the splits sum exactly to the receipt total. For each product pick the most specific category (the subcategory when one fits); if a subcategory is missing, propose creating it with create_category inside the same confirmation list. Several products may share a category. A discount is not a line: subtract it from the amounts of the lines it applies to (a global discount, from the largest product or spread) so the sum stays the total paid. Before writing, show the list (product, amount, category, discounts, total) and ask one single yes. An income into a fund account needs contributedByMemberId («Whose»). BEFORE calling it, look for a duplicate with list_movements and CONFIRM with the person what you are about to write (account, amount, date, category). Generate a requestRef (UUID) per movement and reuse it on a retry: it never duplicates. Returns the movement id.
tools.updateMovement: Fixes a movement the person can write. It is a patch: send only what changes and the rest stays as it is. Pass the updatedAt you read in list_movements as expectedUpdatedAt: if someone edited it meanwhile, it is refused. CONFIRM the change with the person before calling it. The rules of record_movement apply: card or loan payments and moves between own accounts are transfers, and the description says what and where, never the payment method.
tools.deleteMovement: Deletes a movement the person can write. It cannot be undone: CONFIRM with the person which one before calling it.
tools.createAccount: Creates an account with an opening balance in cents on a date: asset (bank or cash) or liability (card, what is owed goes positive). placement «personal» or «group» (the fund's). parentAccountId makes it a pocket of an open asset account of the same owner and currency, one level only. CONFIRM name, kind, currency and balance with the person before calling it, and check with list_accounts that it does not exist yet.
tools.updateAccount: Fixes an account the person can write: name, subtype, currency, institution, last four digits, parentAccountId (the account it sits inside as a pocket, null to take it out), opening balance in cents and its date. It is a patch: send only what changes. Pass the updatedAt you read in list_accounts as expectedUpdatedAt: if someone edited it meanwhile, it is refused. CONFIRM the change with the person before calling it, above all the opening balance.
tools.moveAccountToFund: Moves one of the person's PERSONAL accounts into the fund they belong to, with everything it holds: same id, balance, movements and pockets (a pocket moves with its main account, never alone). From then on any member of the fund sees and writes it; its movements stop counting in personal budgets; its personal categories and labels are swapped for the fund's ones with the same name (if one is missing it is refused and says which kind); the incomes it already has are left without «From whom». It is refused when a personal budget or goal points at the account, and when it is cash and the fund already has its shared cash. It cannot be undone: CONFIRM with the person which account moves and that they understand all of this before calling it. Check first with list_accounts and list_categories.
tools.createCategory: Creates a category (expense or income), optionally under a parent of the same kind and scope. placement «personal» or «group». CONFIRM with the person before calling it and check with list_categories that it does not exist yet.
tools.updateCategory: Renames a category or moves it under another parent of the same kind (parentId) or to the top level (parentId null). It is a patch: send only what changes. A category that has subcategories cannot go under another, and a parent of another kind is refused. Check list_categories first. Show the person the change and ask one yes before calling it.
tools.mergeMovements: Merges 2 or more expenses, or 2 or more incomes, of ONE account into one movement (a receipt booked as one movement per product): its lines are the originals' (each one's category and amount, its description as the line's name; an original that has lines gives each) and the total is their sum. The originals are DELETED, all or nothing. Optional description and occurredAt (default: the earliest date). The new movement drops the originals' review marks and recurring-rule link. Refused: transfers, mixed accounts or kinds, movements imported from a statement or tied to a planned payment, goal, deferral or instalment, movements that caused or are a charge of another, ones with an external reference or awaiting a counterparty, and anyone else's. Find them with list_movements, show the person the list (originals, resulting lines, total) and ask one single yes before calling it.
tools.moveCategoryMovements: Moves every movement line of EXACTLY category fromCategoryId (not the lines of its subcategories, although list_movements by category includes them) to toCategoryId, in one statement, optionally only those dated from..to; both must have the same kind. Call it FIRST with dryRun true: it writes nothing and returns how many lines would move. Show that count to the person, ask one yes, then call it without dryRun. Each movement moved gets a new updatedAt, so re-read it with list_movements before editing it.
tools.listInbox: The inbox: the deliveries (bank SMS, emails, webhook) waiting for the person's approval. Each carries id, receivedAt, rawText (the message as it arrived) and proposal (amountCents, currency, kind expense or income, accountId and accountName, categoryId and categoryPath, date, description). notDetected names the fields the message did not give. status (default pending) filters; limit and offset page. Call it FIRST. Then show the person ONE compact list (date, amount, account, category, description), with every missing field filled in from your proposal and marked as such, and ask for ONE yes for the whole list, or their corrections. Then call accept_deliveries; whatever the person drops is rejected with reject_deliveries, confirmed in that same list.
tools.acceptDeliveries: Approves one or more inbox deliveries: each becomes a movement, by the same path and rules as HomeFund's «Accept» button (kind derived from the accounts, audit, the delivery's reference prevents duplicates). Each item carries the id from list_inbox and, only when it changes or is missing, accountId (the expense or income account), categoryId or splits (lines with categoryId, amountCents and the product's description, summing to the amount), amountCents, description, date (YYYY-MM-DD), kind (expense, income or transfer) and, for a transfer, fromAccountId and toAccountId (without kind transfer a lone side is refused; with transfer, the missing side is the proposal's account). For an income into a fund account (notDetected carries contributor), pass contributedByMemberId («De quién»). All or nothing: if one delivery fails (for example no account, amount or category, already resolved, or someone else's) none is accepted and the error carries deliveryId and the missing field. NEVER call it without first calling list_inbox, showing the person the compact list (date, amount, account, category, description) and receiving ONE yes for the whole list.
tools.rejectDeliveries: Rejects one or more inbox deliveries by id, by the same path as «Reject» in HomeFund; it writes no movement. All or nothing: if an id is not one of the person's pending deliveries, none is rejected. First show the list (date, amount, description) of what you will reject, together with the accept_deliveries one, and ask for ONE yes for all of it.

errors.unauthorized: The key is not valid or was revoked.
errors.unknown: It could not be done. Try again.
errors.openMonth: Only a closed month is reviewed: ask for one before the current month.

statement.notFound: The account does not exist, is archived or you cannot see it.
statement.readOnly: You cannot record movements in that account.
statement.previewChanged: The lines are not the preview's: call preview_statement again.
statement.invalidLines: Some lines are invalid: fix or remove them and preview again.
statement.lineRefused: A line could not be recorded; nothing was imported.

missing.amount: The delivery has no amount: give amountCents.
missing.account: The delivery has no account: give accountId.
missing.category: The delivery has no category: give categoryId or splits.

inbox.sideNeedsTransfer: A lone fromAccountId or toAccountId only applies to a transfer: pass kind transfer or use accountId.
inbox.duplicate: That delivery is already booked as a movement.

merge.count: Give two or more different movements to merge.
merge.mixed: The movements must be of one account, one kind, currency and contributor, and each one needs a category.
merge.linked: A movement tied to a statement, planned payment, goal, deferral, instalment or charge, with an external reference or awaiting a counterparty cannot be merged: it would lose that link.

params.fromAccountId: Source account (id from list_accounts): null on an income.
params.toAccountId: Destination account (id from list_accounts): null on an expense.
params.currency: COP or USD; absent, the accounts' own.
params.counterAmountCents: What left or arrived, in cents, in the account of another currency.
params.counterIsEstimate: true while that second amount is an estimate, not what the bank billed.
params.occurredAt: Movement date, YYYY-MM-DD, never in the future.
params.description: Short text: merchant or concept; any note goes here too.
params.categoryId: Shortcut: one category (id from list_categories) for the whole amount.
params.splits: The movement's lines: each with categoryId, amountCents and optionally description (the product); the amounts sum to the movement's.
params.contributedByMemberId: «Whose»: the fund member; required on an income into a fund account.
params.forHousehold: true for a household expense paid from a personal account.
params.requestRef: A UUID you generate per movement the person wants; on a retry reuse the same one and it never duplicates.
params.expectedUpdatedAt: The updatedAt list_movements returned; if someone edited it since, it is refused as stale.
params.limit: How many to return, 1 to 200; default 50.
params.accountSubtype: bank, cash, card or loan (a loan; only with kind liability).
params.openingBalanceCents: Opening balance in cents; on a card, what is owed, positive.
params.balanceOn: The date the opening balance is true as of, YYYY-MM-DD.
params.parentAccountId: Id of the asset account this one is a pocket of, from list_accounts; null for an account of its own.
params.parentId: Parent category id of the same kind, or null.
params.categoryPlacement: personal or group; absent, the fund when the person has one.
params.color: A palette colour; absent, the first free one.
params.filterCategoryId: Only movements with a line in this category or one of its subcategories (id from list_categories).
params.offset: How many to skip, for paging; default 0.
params.transactionIds: The ids (from list_movements) of 2 to 50 movements of one account and one kind, expense or income.
params.fromCategoryId: The category whose lines move (id from list_categories).
params.toCategoryId: The category that receives them, of the same kind (id from list_categories).
params.dryRun: true: write nothing and only return how many lines would move.
params.deliveries: The deliveries to accept, 1 to 50: each with its id and, optionally, the data that corrects or completes its proposal.
params.deliveryIds: The ids (from list_inbox) of 1 to 50 pending deliveries to reject.
